4) Next steps (owners & timing)
- Priya (me): Send SOC 2 and vendor packet by EOD 5/12.

Hi all — attaching the requested artifacts (stubs below). Quick summary of what I included: 

1) One-page control mapping (attached as SOC2_Control_Mapping_OnePager.pdf stub) — maps our SOC 2 sections to Glacier Bank controls: encryption, access controls, logging, incident response.
2) Technical checklist (6 bullets):
   - TLS 1.2+ enforced in transit; AES-256 at rest supported; KMS integration available via customer-managed keys.
   - Model call token cache: short-lived KV cache, default TTL 300s; configurable per-tenant.
   - Audit logs: per-request token and model metadata shipped to customer-managed logging endpoints (S3/CloudWatch) or Redwoods' audit log retention with export.
   - VPC/private deployment: recommended for regulated data; we can provide an on-prem package or a VPC peering option.
   - Data residency options: US-only region available.
   - Rollout guardrails: rate limits, per-route quotas, and canary model fallbacks documented in ops playbook.

Next steps: Priya to bundle these with the Vendor Form; Anita to confirm PO template required fields. If procurement wants to see sample PO language, I can draft the minimal commercial wording to avoid legal redlines.

Rishi Malhotra
